test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A person has to cover a distance of 8 km in 1 hour. If he covers one-fourth of the distance in one-third of the total time, then what should his speed (in km/h) be to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time so that the person reaches the destination exactly on time?
solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 8 km

Total time = 1 hour

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculations:**

Distance covered in one-third of the time:

One-fourth of 8 km = 8/4 = 2 km

Time taken to cover 2 km:

One-third of 1 hour = 1/3 hour<
